theorems.name: Submission.hsNorm_starProjection_trace_identities
theorems.statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), ‖A‖ ≤ hsNorm A) ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)) (v : Rn m), ‖Tᗮ.starProjection v‖ = Metric.infDist v (T : Set (Rn m))) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (P T : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), Module.finrank ℝ P = Module.finrank ℝ T → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn m) (Tᗮ.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap) = hsNormSq (P.starProjection - T.starProjection) / 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
